description: Phone lines and online contacts, by country, for people who want help to stop gambling, checked by hand by the Silex team. Use when someone asks who they can call or contact about gambling. Returns lines for the country where verified, online contacts that work anywhere, and debt-advice charities for the US and UK.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. US, GB, DE) or English country name. Omit if unknown.
